items.name: nav-link
items.title: NavLink
items.description: react-router NavLink with the YoRHa selected-row look. aria-current=page marks the active row. Forwards props and ref so it works as a MenuList row through a render prop.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Use inside a react-router data or declarative router. Pass render={<NavLink to=... />} to a Base UI row to reuse the selected-row look.
